list: The 100 Greatest Artists of All Time
notes: 2011 updated edition (orig. 2004-05). Ranks come from search-result summaries, not a page read directly. Ranks 1-26 are the same in both editions. Weakest ranks: 44-49, 67-69, 74-81, 84, 87, 93. rock_or_metal is a genre judgment by the collecting session: 1950s rock & roll counts as true; soul/R&B, hip hop, pop, blues, country, folk and reggae count as false.

Aired Sept 2010; voted by 200+ musicians and industry figures (PR Newswire: '100 Greatest Music Artists of All Time'). Ranks come from search-result summaries. Only one search confirmed ranks 71-79, 87, 92, 94 and 95. rock_or_metal is a genre judgment, as for the Rolling Stone list.
